description: Exit a HIP-4 outcome position by SELLING held side tokens (the backend always sells; it cannot short). Structured mode: apiKey, walletAddress (control), sessionPrivateKey, outcomeId, one of coin/sideIndex/sideLabel, price (limit) or isMarket=true, optional size (whole contracts; omit for a full exit — the backend caps size to what you hold). With managedAddress, partial exits must leave both the sold part and the remainder >= 11 quote. Settled markets have no book: GDEX has no claim endpoint, check the HL spot balance instead. Pre-built mode: computedData alone.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

coin.description: Side coin "#<assetId>" from hl_outcomes sides[].coin. Give exactly one of coin / sideIndex / sideLabel.

computedData.description: Pre-built mode ONLY: encrypted payload. Must be sent alone (no structured fields).

managedAddress.description: Managed wallet; enables position-aware partial-exit checks

sideIndex.description: Side index in sides[] (sides are NOT always Yes/No; read the labels)

sideLabel.description: Exact side label from sides[].label, e.g. "No" or a team name

size.description: Contracts to sell; omit for the full position

walletAddress.description: Structured mode: CONTROL wallet address from sign-in (not the managed address)

name: hl_close_outcome_order
